title.value: Seeking Interpretability and Explainability in Binary Activated Neural Networks
title.justification: The title clearly communicates the focus of the paper on interpretability and explainability in the context of a specific type of neural network, which is binary activated neural networks.
title.quote: Seeking Interpretability and Explainability in Binary Activated Neural Networks

extractions.description: The paper explores binary activated neural networks (BANNs) for regression tasks on tabular data. It dissects these networks to understand their workings and proposes a greedy algorithm to build interpretable BANNs by adding neurons one at a time. The work emphasizes the importance of transparency in the prediction process and proposes using SHAP values to quantify the importance of features and neurons. The paper sets forth BANNs as a potential family of interpretable predictors, competitive with tree-based approaches in both performance and interpretability.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The core theme of the paper is about the interpretability and explainability of binary activated neural networks, with no direct mention or implication of climate or ecological sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We study the use of binary activated neural networks as interpretable and explainable predictors in the context of regression tasks on tabular data.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on interpretability in neural networks, specifically with binary activations, without specific application or mention of sustainable development, climate change, or ecological sustainability.
primary_category.quote: ...could neural networks be competitive to models such as tree-based approaches when both empirical performances and interpretability are critical?

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not explicitly address any secondary themes related to climate or ecological sustainable development.
secondary_categories.quote: Our work sets forth a new family of predictors to consider when interpretability is of importance.

primary_sub_category.justification: There is no sub-category related to climate or ecological sustainable development discussed in the paper.
primary_sub_category.quote: We tackle the following question: could neural networks be competitive to models such as tree-based approaches when both empirical performances and interpretability are critical?

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper does not cover any sub-categories related to climate or ecological sustainable development.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: The paper focuses on binary activated neural networks and their interpretability.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper does not introduce or necessitate the introduction of a new category related to climate or ecological sustainable development.
new_primary_category.quote: The study is centered on improving the interpretability of neural networks, not on sustainable applications.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: No new sub-category is suggested as the paper does not relate to sustainable development topics.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: The focus remains on interpretability and explainability within existing ML frameworks.
